description: This Java class implements a mutable builder for constructing responses related to retrieving attributes in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for creating success responses with attributes and error responses for inaccessible attributes, utilizing a fluent API style.

classes.description: A final class implementing a builder for constructing responses to retrieve attributes commands, providing static factory method and response creation logic.
